title: A deployment carries no defaults from another company
description:
Core still has default domains, a family footer and a privacy link that belong to Anthus.

```gherkin
Feature: No borrowed defaults

  Scenario: A fresh deployment names only itself
    Given a deployment with only its own settings
    When the site is built and the backend is deployed
    Then no page, mail or record refers to a domain the site does not own
```
